messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D fighting game inspired by 90s martial arts movies.

## Requirements
- Build now without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at finish.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG (viewport at most 1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created “Neon Fist: Last Round,” a browser-based arcade fighter with a rain-soaked neon dojo, CPU opponent, three-round match, and keyboard/touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the game in `index.html` using Three.js, including fighter models and animations, combat, CPU behavior, HUD, title screen, and mobile controls.
- Served the page locally and opened it in Playwright; page title and canvas loaded.

### Active
- Finish browser verification, including inspecting a screenshot and testing a basic playable interaction.

### Blocked
- No current blocker. Browser logged a missing `favicon.ico` 404 and WebGL performance warnings; no reported JavaScript error.

## Next Move
1. Capture the current page as a JPEG at viewport ≤1280px and inspect it.
2. Start a round and verify controls/combat and check browser console for runtime errors.
3. Report the game and briefly note assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation; currently uncommitted.

## Important Context
- Local server is running at `http://localhost:3002`; Playwright page is open.
- `git status` showed `index.html` and several pre-existing untracked repository files; nothing was committed.
